image_strategy: All food photography is sourced from Unsplash remote image URLs and requires internet access. If an individual menu photo fails, its image element switches to a category-matched Unsplash photo; no illustrated food fallback is included.
testing_status: SQLite migrations 0001-0006 passed local execution; guest online-order and payment-transaction fixtures passed; Cloudflare Pages Functions passed strict TypeScript semantic checking; all TS/TSX files passed syntax transpilation. Full dependency-aware frontend build remains unverified because node_modules are absent in this environment. No live Flutterwave credentials, Cloudflare credentials, remote D1 access, webhook registration, browser testing or deployment were available. Phase 3 implementation is source-complete but not production-ready until secrets, migration, sandbox tests and deployment checks are completed.
notes: Customer registration and sign-in have been retired. Guest checkout uses a client-generated 256-bit access token, stored as a SHA-256 digest in D1; the browser stores the token locally and can recover individual orders using the order reference plus full phone number. Existing order/customer records are retained; historical orders can be recovered individually. Admin login is separate at /admin and uses admin_users/admin_sessions. Actual street address and official logo were not present in source and have not been invented. Phase 4–6 updates add technical SEO metadata, structured data and landmark-based directions. The favicon and social share photo remain provisional because no approved logo/brand image was supplied. Business phone, email, social handles and 24/7 hours are retained from the existing site and need owner confirmation before Google Business Profile verification. Phase 3 adds Flutterwave hosted online checkout and WhatsApp direct payment. Flutterwave secrets are configured as encrypted Cloudflare Pages secrets; live payments require an activated merchant account, D1 migration 0006, webhook registration and sandbox verification. Online payment status is set Paid only after server-side Flutterwave verification.
